Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 0 item 3, §6.

Landed 1.0 work (docs/plans/2026-09-17-one-point-oh-session-1.md and -session-2.md) and the construction-probe anchor beads still read open, review or doing. Several beads are broader than the T-item that landed, so each closes only against its own title. Consolidations already applied when these tickets were filed (2026-09-18): E0 rewritten as a 1.x recall-map extension; the HSMM wire-docs bead merged into support honesty; hosted-API, receipt, forgeability, grain and empty-guard beads linked to this epic.

Scope:
Bring the tracker into agreement with main. Commit the .mote/ops with the change.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Closed with a note citing the landing commit and the proving test, only if the commit covers the bead's own title: PopulationAggregate bd-01M16B4NE7R5HHXT70GFW629ZT (e285fed5); MassRatio bd-01M174W3D9AZG2FGSRM11FZ7ZQ (01cfbc46); the nine construction-probe anchor beads in review (bd-01M1A49W8H5MNJNKFXR84ZQFJP, bd-01M1BY93E78KHABT8CMEASZA4G, bd-01M1BZ5PR6T5G598S9QZWJBEWJ, bd-01M1BZQCM0P8566KACRE28RVAR, bd-01M1C0DA89WDXC9H3VTKJ46R9A, bd-01M1C0XXGBNZ91S4N313JF0HE4, bd-01M1C1S0BRF8H7EX74CGQZVV1M, bd-01M1C2K4PW5F9YS43NZNJ8ZRXV, bd-01M1C3GHNJJ2XX4SQ4BV8042ZB) and the three in doing (bd-01M1C4Q11FWAY7MZFNNMXTTJEJ, bd-01M1C5Y9ESYXAFNT91BVBTKZB9, bd-01M1C6XV4F99RVRWCTF3YX16G7) (6ca05d72..8ec2acb1).
2. Kept open with a note stating what is left: bd-01M1836WDBB72KXXPKG23PSSWT (Mirror.ProductOf door; handoff:108-111 lists four suites still missing it) and bd-01M19NYZT593MXWEERP80RHY8J (whole-surface judgement pass), unless their full titles are shown landed.
3. V1 (bd-01M1CQQDCWN2RTT1Z8XNNB7VMY) moves to priority 3 with tag 1.x and a note citing ruling E.
4. The fleet-era CODE RED parent (bd-01M1CQ2H7VPSKRT02M5H7HN1K6) is closed as superseded by the mapper-plan epic once its remaining children are all linked to this epic (D1A-types, D1A-film, D1B, E0, V1).
5. Checked and closed with a citation, or kept with a reason: the movie time and mapping contract amendment bd-01M199ABAG5SXR9C6Y0G4X6J2T (its six distinctions against core/source.scala; any remainder is added to the D1A-types S2 ticket as a note); the admitted-story loader bd-01M17010MM68DG7B49DMEKA2AA (against the intake contract's corpus readers); the Astro docs bead bd-01M19FPY1EC5QNTW6SBG3QYT3R (docs-site exists; deployment is the release-infrastructure ticket).
6. Every remaining 'doing' bead has a progress note dated within 10 days or is moved back to open with its fleet assignee released.
7. The closing note gives `mote ls` counts by status before and after.

Gate: fresh-context cold review of the committed text; the commit body states what changed and
what it does not establish.

Size: S.
set.title: Phase 0: tracker hygiene -- close landed beads against their own titles, move V1 to 1.x, retire the fleet epic
